text:
Mira: quick lane check — we need to finalize cross-team deps for the Q3 customer-low-latency pilot. Major asks: private deploy + per-tenant HSM opt-in. Who has hard blockers?
Jae: runtime: 4-bit quant stability is the main risk. Small validation harness should surface regressions; estimate 10 business days.
Priya: infra: Dedicated pools need slot reservations and peered VPCs. I can request slots but need GPU SKU + qps estimate.
Omar: security: HSM integration requires design review. Suggest a canary path without enforced HSM to speed time-to-first-customer. We'll accept limited exposure for canary.
Mira: product ok with canary without enforced HSM for low-risk tenants. Need feature flag + rollback playbook.
Rina: platform will add a flag. Config sketch:
feature_flags.require_hsm=false
fallback.on_hsm_error=software_kms
Mira: add acceptance criteria: P50 <120ms, no hallucination regression, toggle works in staging.
Jae: timeline: week1 kernel bench, week2 e2e with prewarm, week3 canary. Parallelize if infra reserves slots sooner.
Priya: locking GPU: GA3/16GB target. QPS: ~20-30/s initial. I'll open tickets and assign owners.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-812 "require_hsm flag" assigned to Rina.
Mira: owners: Jae(runtime), Priya(infra), Omar(security), Rina(flag/routing). Check-in in 48h, ping thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
